ranked_findings.summary: Bulk-refund requests accepted without idempotency keys, causing duplicate refunds
evidence: corpus/logs/api_gateway_2026-05-01.log — entries at 10:17:44Z and 10:17:46Z show request_class=bulk-refund with idempotency_key=missing and status=accepted
corpus/timeline/incident_timeline.md — bulk refund requests accepted without idempotency keys at 10:17 UTC
corpus/tickets/TICKET-8729.md — every duplicate has request_class=bulk-refund and no idempotency key; single-refund traffic unaffected

ranked_findings.summary: idempotency-required guardrail skipped due to legacy_batch_header bypass
evidence: corpus/timeline/incident_timeline.md — guardrail skipped due to legacy_batch_header at 10:18 UTC

ranked_findings.summary: Worker replay theory (TICKET-8721) not supported as primary trigger by final evidence
evidence: corpus/tickets/TICKET-8721.md — initial theory was queue worker replay, opened before API gateway logs were available
corpus/tickets/TICKET-8729.md — single-refund API traffic in same window did not duplicate, contradicting a general replay issue

unresolved_ambiguity: Worker replay was an early symptom theory but is not supported as the primary trigger by final evidence
